description_en: Moves a resource to another resource group
description_zh: 修改云资源所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun alb move-resource-group --resource-type acl --resource-id acl-hp34s2h0xx1ht4nwo0000 --new-resource-group-id rg-aekzbi7000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

loadbalancer: Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance

acl: access control list (ACL)

securitypolicy: security policy

servergroup: server group
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改资源组的云资源类型，取值：


loadbalancer：应用型负载均衡实例
acl：访问控制
securitypolicy：安全策略
servergroup：服务器组
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_zh: 需要修改资源组的云资源的实例ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which you want to transfer the cloud resource.

You can use resource groups to manage resources within your Alibaba Cloud account by group. This helps you resolve issues such as resource grouping and permission management for your Alibaba Cloud account. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.help_zh:
需要移入云资源实例的资源组ID。

资源组是在阿里云账号下进行资源分组管理的一种机制，资源组能够帮助您解决单个云账号内的资源分组和授权管理等复杂性问题。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id
